reasons: The original PDF5 defines Theta through positive finite limsup, so empty windows do not refute the stated sharpness. The report and coverage consistently leave full kernel/bilinear proofs and general Bieberbach periodization unproved.

Interpolating the stated 2-to-2 and 1-to-infinity bounds yields N exponent 1-alpha(1-2/q); summing dyadic terms gives the two recorded log powers after the square root, with strict threshold and fixed q>2. The equality case would introduce log T and is not asserted. The orthogonal-window Cauchy-Schwarz argument is valid conditional on unit-band sharpness.

Actual source image PDF15 shows both distance-time notation in (2.26) and constant-flow invariance in (2.27). Euclidean flow yields signed hitting time -h/xi_n rather than positive distance h. The intended transversal extension is explicit nearby; the report limits this to notation and does not infer a false theorem.
The flat-model normalization and counting identity give (2*17^2+1)/(3*17)=193/17; this is a bounded illustration, not a proof of arbitrary compact flat quotients.
